sourceText: Fix the audit-discovered portability defects: validation lock is per-projectRoot (not shared across worktrees) and the done-required command-spec digest embeds an absolute cwd.
normalizedOutcome: The same story serializes validation across worktrees/hosts (one shared lock), and a command-spec digest is identical for the same logical command across worktree roots while legacy receipts still verify.
acceptanceClaim: The worktree-portability smoke shows validationExecutionLockPath is root-independent and buildDoneRequiredCommandSpecEnvelope digests are root-independent with legacy receipts still accepted.
